name: publicWeb_savePageLayout
description: Saves (updates, or inserts a minimal row for) the Puck page-layout JSON of a kennel's public website. Called by the Next.js admin layout editor through PublicWebAdminApi, which requires HC_INTERNAL_SECRET; the editor route itself checks the HMAC admin session (from the portal's one-time token) for the same kennel slug. The SP has no auth of its own — it trusts that chain. Rejects JSON that fails ISJSON(). A first save inserts KennelWebsite with Enabled left at its default 0, so saving a layout never publishes a website.

parameters.name: KennelSlug
parameters.description: URL slug of the kennel (HC.Kennel.KennelUniqueShortName, deleted = 0, removed = 0). No SQL default.
parameters.typeMismatch: Kennel.KennelUniqueShortName is NVARCHAR(50); the parameter is NVARCHAR(100). A longer slug simply matches nothing ('Kennel not found.').

parameters.name: PageLayoutJson
parameters.description: JSON blob of shape PageLayoutBlob = Partial<Record<PageType, Data>>. Must pass SQL Server ISJSON() validation. No SQL default.

rowsets.name: SaveResult
rowsets.description: Always one row: Success 1 after the commit; Success 0 with 'Kennel not found.', 'PageLayoutJson is not valid JSON.' or ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH. PublicWebAdminApi logs any Success = 0 envelope and returns 400.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success; error description on failure

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.KennelWebsite SET PageLayoutJson, updatedAt = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() when the kennel has a row.
Otherwise INSERT HC.KennelWebsite (KennelId, PageLayoutJson) — every other column, including Enabled (0), takes its default.

codeSmells.detail: @KennelSlug, @PageLayoutJson (line 2-3) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one fails with 'expects parameter' before the SP runs: PublicWebAdminApi's catch logs only a generic exception row and returns 500, and the SP's own graceful checks and error envelope never run.

Line 43's IF EXISTS is not locked, so two concurrent first saves for a kennel can both reach the INSERT (line 55) and the second fails on the KennelWebsite primary key — returned as Success = 0 with the PK message. Add WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) to the existence check.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 63-66 return { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } without an HC.ErrorLog row. PublicWebAdminApi logs the envelope as 'HC6 Public Web Admin Error: savePageLayout', so it is visible, but without the slug.

Any caller holding HC_INTERNAL_SECRET can overwrite any kennel's layout by slug; the per-kennel admin check lives only in the Next.js route. Acceptable while the secret is server-only, but nothing in SQL backs it up.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove the Success/ErrorMessage columns — the Next.js route checks Success to show toast feedback
Never change the Enabled=0 default on auto-insert — the admin must explicitly enable the website separately
Never remove the ISJSON() check — it prevents corrupted blobs reaching the DB
